description: One update step (dt = 0.25 yr = 3 months) of hydrology::Routing (PISM's default hydrology.model = 'routing', Shreve q = -K grad psi) on the verification test-F exact geometry (flat bed, thickness = exact FG H, Mx=My=31, Lx=Ly=900 km). Prescribed deterministic forcing: constant surface input rate 0.2 m/yr water-equivalent (6.338e-6 kg m^-2 s^-1 in the model's units), dome-centered basal melt blob 0.1 m/yr * exp(-(r/200 km)^2), constant ice sliding speed 100 m/yr (a Hydrology Inputs contract member that Routing ignores -- it is only used by hydrology::Distributed; dumped for completeness). Initial state: dry till W_till = 0 everywhere (it absorbs the input over the step), and a dome-centered transportable-water blob W = 0.5 m * exp(-(r/150 km)^2) whose drainage drives the flux trace. All forcing and the geometry are radially symmetric, so the flux field is exactly centrally anti-symmetric.

regenerate.note: Run from the repo root. Override grid with -Mx/-My, step with -dt_years, output with -dumps_dir. Overwriting an existing inputs.nc makes the netCDF library leave an inputs.nc~ backup in the dumps directory (delete or ignore it).

domain.note: 2-D grid only (no vertical levels needed for the basal boundary); exact test-F thickness, bed = 0, sea level = 0

time.substep_note: 19 internal substeps, average dt = 415223 s (~4.8 days); the substep is CFL-limited to ~435465 s (~5 days) by max_timestep_W_cfl(), dominated by the eps = 1e-6 regularization term in the denominator at these velocities (V/dx ~ 5e-8 << 1e-6). max_timestep_W_diff() gives dt_diff ~ 6.8e8 s (~21.5 yr), so the diffusion limit is not binding.

setup.default_config: all hydrology.*, constants.*, grid.* keys at their defaults; hydrology.model explicitly set to 'routing'

test_F.note: geometry.ice_free_thickness_standard at its default for the mask

forcing.surface_input_rate: 0.2 m/yr water-equivalent, constant under ice; passed in the model's units (kg m^-2 s^-1) = 6.337753e-6 kg m^-2 s^-1 (= 0.2 m/yr * rho_w)
forcing.basal_melt_rate: 0.1 m/yr * exp(-(r/200 km)^2) in ice-equivalent m/s (peak 3.168876e-9 m/s at the dome)
forcing.ice_sliding_speed: 100 m/yr = 3.168876e-6 m/s, constant (ignored by Routing; part of the Inputs contract)
forcing.W_till_in: 0 everywhere (dry till; absorbs dt*(surface + basal) = up to 0.0725 m over the step, below tillwat_max = 2 m)
forcing.W_in: 0.5 m * exp(-(r/150 km)^2): dome-centered transportable-water blob (sum 10.483 m over the domain)

setup.coupling_notes: The dumped flux() is the *advective* flux q = V*W_upwind with V = -K grad R, R = P + rho_w g b. The diffusive part rho_w g K W grad W is applied separately inside the W update (W_change_due_to_flow) and is NOT part of the dumped flux. Effective pressure is NOT computed here -- it is downstream in MohrCoulombYieldStress (basal_strength boundary).

dump_files.meta.txt: pism revision, config file, component, description, dt, grid, cell_area, command line
dump_files.parameters.csv: hydrology.*, constants.*, grid.* config keys (values + units)
dump_files.inputs.nc: geometry (usurf, thk, topg, mask, sea_level), inputs (no_model_mask, surface_input_rate, basal_melt_rate, ice_sliding_speed + the model's converted water-input fields water_input_rate_from_surface/basal_melt in m/s), state in/out (W_till_in, tillwat, W_in, bwat), outputs (overburden_pressure, uwater_flux, vwater_flux)
dump_files.flux_law.csv: pointwise Routing flux law: K = k W^(alpha-1) (G^2 + eps^2)^((beta-2)/2) (eps = 1 for beta < 2) and |q| = K W G sampled over W in [0,4] m and G = |grad R| in [0,1000] Pa/m -- the analytic .esm test target
dump_files.staggered.csv: internal subassembly fields from the last internal substep on the staggered (edge) grid: (i,j,o) with x/y coordinates, Wstag, Kstag, Vstag, Qstag, and the accumulated Qstag_average over the whole step

checks.mass_balance_model: sum(mass_change) = sum(input + flow + margin + grounding_line + conservation_error + no_model_mask) to round-off: residual = 0 kg
checks.mass_balance_state: independent recomputation dV - dt*(surf+basal volume) - flow - boundary corrections = -7.147e-4 m^3 (relative to dt*input volume 9.001e10 m^3: ~8e-15); boundary-correction volume = -5.414e6 m^3 (water that drained to the grounded ice margin)
checks.w_till_bounds: W_till in [0, 0.0725] m (non-negative everywhere; max = dt*(0.2 m/yr surface + 0.1 m/yr basal at dome) - decay)
checks.w_bounds: W in [0, 0.283302] m (initial blob 0.5 m drains to 0.1488 m at the dome; the max moves outward to r ~ 82 km)
checks.overburden: overburden_pressure = rho_ice*g*H exactly: max |P - rho_i g H| = 0 Pa over 517 grounded cells
checks.flux_direction: q . grad R <= 0 where R = P + rho_w g b (the potential the advection follows): max q.gradR = 0 over 516 grounded cells with |q| > 0; flux points radially outward from the dome (e.g. at cell (i,j) = (15,13), q = (0, -8.145e-4) m^2/s at x=0, y=-116 km)
checks.flux_symmetry: central anti-symmetry for the radially symmetric forcing: max |q(i,j) + q(Mx-1-i, My-1-j)| = 3.4286e-19 m^2 s^-1 (relative 4.2e-16)
checks.substeps: 19 internal substeps, average dt = 415223 s (~4.8 days); dt_cfl = 435465 s (eps = 1e-6 CFL regularization dominates at V/dx ~ 5e-8), dt_diff = 6.793e8 s (~21.5 yr)
checks.center_cell: dome cell (15,15): H = 3000 m, W_in = 0.5 m, W_out = 0.1488 m, W_till_out = 0.0725 m, overburden = 2.67813e7 Pa, flux = 0 (radial symmetry)
